Class ContainerTabs.Keyed<K>

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.panel.ContainerTabs.Keyed<K>
Enclosing class:
ContainerTabs
public static final class ContainerTabs.Keyed<K> extends Object
Builds a keyed list of tabs (ContainerTabs.keyed(String, ModeScope, Supplier)). Its screens, order and edge are the list's, shared by every tab in it; each key's tab sets the rest.

  • Method Details

    • tab

      public ContainerTabs.Keyed<K> tab(BiConsumer<? super K, ContainerTabs.Builder> build)
      Required: each key's tab, set up on a builder as a declared tab is (its icon, tooltip, what a click does, when it shows, draws selected or is disabled), minus declare(), its screens, order and edge, which are the list's: setting those on it throws. Run once per key, the frame the key first appears; what the tab shows that changes reads through suppliers, by key.

    • header

      public ContainerTabs.Keyed<K> header(Consumer<ContainerTabs.Builder> build)
      Makes the list a group: build sets up its header tab, as a key's tab is set up, and the keys' tabs become its sub-tabs, standing after it. The header shows while its own visibleWhen holds, with or without keys, and its sub-tabs only with it. What a click on it does is its onClick, the mod's (show its own page, pick its first sub-tab). Its id is the list's. Without tabSize(int, int), sub-tabs are 18 by 17.

    • expandedWhen

      public ContainerTabs.Keyed<K> expandedWhen(BooleanSupplier condition)
      When a group's sub-tabs are out, read every frame: always, only while one of them is selected, or whatever the mod's own rule is. Default: always. MenuKit slides them out from under the header to its right as this starts holding and back under it as it stops, in 200 ms, a turn mid-way going back from where they are. Only for a list with a header.

    • tabSize

      public ContainerTabs.Keyed<K> tabSize(int width, int height)
      Every key's tab's size, as ContainerTabs.Builder.size(int, int) takes it, before a key's own size. Default: a full tab, or a group's sub-tab size with a header.

    • order

      public ContainerTabs.Keyed<K> order(int order)
      Where the list goes in its row, every tab of it together, in the keys' order: lower is further left; ties go by id. Default 0.

    • edge

      public ContainerTabs.Keyed<K> edge(ContainerTabs.Edge edge)
      The edge its row stands on. Default ContainerTabs.Edge.CONTAINERS_TOP.

    • on
